name: dnstwist
summary: Domain name permutation engine for detecting typo squatting, phishing and corporate espionage.
highlights: -a — Print all DNS records instead of the first ones
-b — Determine HTTP and SMTP service banners
-d — Generate more domains using dictionary FILE
-f — Output format: cli, csv, json, list (default: cli)
--fuzzers — Use only selected fuzzing algorithms (separated with commas)
--lsh — Evaluate web page similarity with LSH algorithm: ssdeep, tlsh (default: ssdeep)
--lsh-url — Override URL to fetch the original web page from

flags.name: --all
